# `capability-trifecta`

**Page rule** · `warning` · on by default

A tool that returns content the author does not control, without declaring it, on a page that also exposes tools which act on the user's behalf: that content can steer the agent into calling them.

A page rule judges the tool surface as a whole, so it needs a full snapshot: the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler, or `lint()` over a snapshot you collected yourself. Static analysis of a single `registerTool()` call cannot run it.

## Options

| Option               | Default   |
| -------------------- | --------- |
| `sources`            | see below |
| `sinks`              | see below |
| `maxNamed`           | `3`       |
| `requireDeclaration` | `true`    |

<details>
<summary><code>sources</code> default</summary>

```json
"\\b(comments?|reviews?|messages?|inbox|mail|emails?|feed|posts?|threads?|repl(?:y|ies)|submissions?|tickets?|issues?|mentions?|notifications?|chats?|testimonials?|guestbook|scrape|crawl|browse)\\b"
```

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>sinks</code> default</summary>

```json
"\\b(send|email|mail|post|publish|share|submit|upload|tweet|message|notify|invite|webhook|export|forward|sync)\\b"
```

</details>

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "capability-trifecta": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "capability-trifecta": "warning" } }); // change severity
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "capability-trifecta": { maxNamed: 3 } } });
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule capability-trifecta=off
```
